changes.text: The ambush had been waiting for exactly that. With the Zhao camp emptied, the two thousand riders swept in, pulled down the Zhao banners and raised two thousand red ones of Han. Unable to win in front and unable to catch Han Xin, the Zhao troops turned for their camp and found the walls all hung with Han's red banners. Greatly alarmed, they believed the Han had already taken the king of Zhao and his generals. The army dissolved; commanders cut men down to hold the line and could not. The Han struck from both sides, routed the Zhao army, killed the Lord of Cheng'an on the banks of the Zhi, and took King Xie alive.
埋伏的二千轻骑等的就是这一刻：赵营空了，他们驰入营垒，拔掉赵旗，插上二千面汉军红旗。赵军在前面不能取胜、又抓不到韩信，想回营时，看到的是「壁皆漢赤幟」，大惊，以为汉军已经把赵王和将领都拿下了，队伍顿时乱了，将领杀人弹压也止不住。汉军前后夹击，大破赵军，斩成安君于泜水上，擒赵王歇。

dispositions.rationale: 英文把原文「以爲」译作“they were sure”，语气过强。现改为“they believed”，与原文和中文“以为”一致。中文字段原样保留，按中英同步规则一并给出完整文字。

evidence.quote: 而大驚，以爲漢皆已得趙王將矣
